items.source: this constructor has been superseded by Handle(int, String, String, String, boolean).
items.translation: 此构造函数已被Handle(int, String, String, String, boolean)取代。

items.source: Constructs a new field or method handle.
items.translation: 构造一个新的字段或方法句柄。

items.source: tag - the kind of field or method designated by this Handle. Must be Opcodes.H_GETFIELD, Opcodes.H_GETSTATIC, Opcodes.H_PUTFIELD, Opcodes.H_PUTSTATIC, Opcodes.H_INVOKEVIRTUAL, Opcodes.H_INVOKESTATIC, Opcodes.H_INVOKESPECIAL, Opcodes.H_NEWINVOKESPECIAL or Opcodes.H_INVOKEINTERFACE.
items.translation: tag - 此 Handle 指定的字段或方法的类型。必须是Opcodes.H_GETFIELD、Opcodes.H_GETSTATIC、Opcodes.H_PUTFIELD、Opcodes.H_PUTSTATIC、Opcodes.H_INVOKEVIRTUAL、Opcodes.H_INVOKESTATIC、Opcodes.H_INVOKESPECIAL、Opcodes.H_NEWINVOKESPECIAL 或Opcodes.H_INVOKEINTERFACE。

items.source: owner - the internal name of the class that owns the field or method designated by this handle (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: owner - 拥有此句柄所指定的字段或方法的类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: name - the name of the field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: name - 此句柄指定的字段或方法的名称。

items.source: descriptor - the descriptor of the field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: descriptor - 此句柄所指定的字段或方法的描述符。

items.source:
Returns the textual representation of this handle. The textual representation is:
  • for a reference to a class: owner "." name descriptor " (" tag ")",
  • for a reference to an interface: owner "." name descriptor " (" tag " itf)".
items.translation:
返回此句柄的文本表示形式。文本表示形式为：
  • 对于类的引用：所有者 "." 名称描述符 " (" 标签 ")"，
  • 对于接口的引用：所有者 "." 名称描述符 " (" 标签 " itf)"。

items.source: Returns the descriptor of the field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: 返回此句柄指定的字段或方法的描述符。

items.source: Returns the name of the field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: 返回此句柄指定的字段或方法名称。

items.source: Returns the internal name of the class that owns the field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: 返回拥有此句柄指定的字段或方法的类的内部名称。

items.source: Returns the kind of field or method designated by this handle.
items.translation: 返回此句柄指定的字段或方法的类型。

items.source: Returns true if the owner of the field or method designated by this handle is an interface.
items.translation: 如果此句柄指定的字段或方法的所有者是接口，则返回 true。

items.source: the internal name of the class that owns the field or method designated by this handle (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: 该句柄所指定的字段或方法所属类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: isInterface - whether the owner is an interface or not.
items.translation: isInterface - 所有者是否为接口。

items.source: Remi Forax, Eric Bruneton
